note: The director's frozen R60 agenda, as DATA. Selected from the ten hypotheses Phase 2 certified live; six of the sixteen Phase-1 hypotheses died on data certification and three more were dropped here on the merits. Foundation declarations below are the data-foundation, universe-construction and feature-library declarations; preregistration.py applies them mechanically through the pipeline. Nothing here is a result.
safety: RESEARCH ONLY. PAPER ONLY. NO ORDERS, NO FILLS, NO PROMOTION, NO ADOPTION, NO BACKFILL. NEW_PAID_DATA_COST = $0.

evaluation_sample.sequential_reveal: D -> V -> L. A halted cell NEVER computes its lockbox and still settles, charging the burden denominator.
evaluation_sample.turnover_ceiling: 0.40 one-way per decision. Measured feature-side turnover above the ceiling HALTS the cell; it is never retuned into compliance, because a retune is a new experiment and a new burden charge.
evaluation_sample.effective_observation_disclosure: Every futures cell must report its effective observation count UP FRONT, before any test statistic, because CALENDAR_TERM_STRUCTURE_ROLL_STATE_R59 was withdrawn on ~14 effective observations.

dropped_on_the_merits.PH02_EQ_EXTENSION_RESIDUAL_MOMENTUM: Dropped. Its own Phase-1 text names it the weakest novelty claim in the pool - a price formula on a new panel. In a campaign whose thesis is NEW INFORMATION, a residualised 12-2 rank is old information on a new population, and every settled cell charges the denominator the genuinely new-information cells must clear.
dropped_on_the_merits.PH13_EQ_EXTENSION_IDIOSYNCRATIC_VOLATILI: Dropped. Price-derived, LOW prior, and its economic case depends on the short leg: the correction requires shorting small, volatile, hard-to-borrow names. This campaign cannot demonstrate a small-cap short leg is expressible, so the cell's own mechanism is not executable as stated.
dropped_on_the_merits.PH01_EQ_EXTENSION_LIQUIDITY_PREMIUM: Dropped. MEDIUM prior but self-defeating at this cost level: the premium being harvested IS the trading cost, and the extension book pays 25 bp/side into exactly the names whose illiquidity is the signal. It is also the same payment-for-immediacy mechanism as PH12, and only one slot was available for that mechanism. PH12 was kept over it because PH12 additionally occupies the H1-H5 horizon frontier (38 tests in the entire estate) and states the cost assumption as the experiment rather than as an obstacle.

selection_record.headline_bet_status: The director's Phase-1 headline bet (LME physical inventory, PH05/PH06/PH14) is DEAD on DATA_HOLD: publication lag unmeasurable and a tradable cross-section of N=1. It is not revived, not renamed and not partially rebuilt.

diversity_record.reasoning: The >=50% non-equity target is MET, and it is met by SUBTRACTING three weak equity price-formula cells rather than by ADDING non-equity price formulas. Both deep non-equity information sources failed certification (LME, terms-of-trade), so the non-equity side could not grow on information; the only legitimate addition available, XA_BASIS_MOMENTUM_REPLICATION, was taken on its merits and not as ballast. Four of eight cells are non-equity, four asset classes are represented, no class exceeds 50%, one H1-H5 cell and one CROSS_ASSET cell are present.
diversity_record.owning_agent_note: trend-breadth-signal-agent owns NO cell this campaign. No family was invented to give it one: the certified information sources are positioning, carry, fundamental and event sources, none of which routes to TREND/BREAKOUT/BREADTH/REGIME/SEASONALITY/CROSS_ASSET_LEAD_LAG. The spawn plan should dispatch three signal agents, not four.

family_routing_corrections.PH04: Phase-1 family CORPORATE_FINANCING is NOT a routed family and would be REFUSED at pre-registration. Registered as VALUATION (reversal-signal-agent). Net share issuance is a revealed managerial VALUATION opinion - managers issue when their own equity is dear and repurchase when it is cheap - so VALUATION is the economically correct routed family, not FUNDAMENTAL_MOMENTUM and not QUALITY.
family_routing_corrections.PH09: Phase-1 listed owning_agent momentum-signal-agent with family EVENT_OVERREACTION, which routes to reversal-signal-agent and contradicts the hypothesis. The claim is CONTINUATION after a fundamental event (expected_sign +1), i.e. underreaction, not overreaction. Registered as FUNDAMENTAL_MOMENTUM (momentum-signal-agent).
family_routing_corrections.PH15: Phase-1 listed owning_agent trend-breadth-signal-agent with family POSITIONING. POSITIONING routes to volatility-liquidity-agent; owner corrected.

Daily membership flags are observable at the date they describe and are NEVER forward-filled beyond availability. Adjusted Close for returns; Unadjusted Close for any volume-weighted or price-level calculation. Dividend field is populated only on ex-dividend dates and is zero otherwise - do not impute.
datasets.survivorship: 2,947 names, 5,714 sessions, 2004-01-02 .. 2026-09-18. 2,687 names were ever members; 1,683 have membership ending before panel end, and a 400-name sample was priced on its LAST membership session in 400 of 400 cases.
datasets.measured_cross_section: 182 decisions; tradable cross-section median 1000, min 978, max 1004; ZERO decisions below 150.
limitations: Per-symbol first_quoted_date governs usable depth, not panel start; post-2010 IPOs carry shorter history.
Vendor-reconstructed membership: inter-index revisions are invisible. Does not affect PIT status.
DF1's 'median 255 names/year' was a 500-symbol sample statistic about symbols-appearing-in-a-year and is superseded by the built panel's median 1000 tradable names per decision.

datasets.supersedes: CERTIFICATION_DF3_FUTURES_PAIRS.json (DATA_HOLD) - the deferred leg was RESCUED by measurement after it was reported unbuildable.
datasets.availability_rule: SIGNAL_LAG_SESSIONS = 1 for ret and ret2: a feature at date T uses windows ending T-1. OI_LAG = 2 sessions with a provisional newest row: open interest at date T may not be used at T or T-1. Nothing is forward filled; a market that did not trade on a grid session is NaN.
datasets.survivorship: Dated-contract record, not a back-adjusted continuation. 68 markets, 12,632 sessions, 1977-11-21 .. 2026-08-21. Layer materialised 2026-08-22; data beyond 2026-08-21 is out of scope.
datasets.deferred_leg: ret2 populated on 98.6% of ret, provably distinct from ret (2.51% exactly equal, max diff 0.626); 67 of 68 markets carry >= 2,000 paired sessions; one market below that floor on Norgate-side early-history thinness.
datasets.MANDATORY_LIMITATION_OPEN_INTEREST: open_interest == 0.0 is MISSING EVERYWHERE, not only on the newest provisional row: 63 provisional newest rows plus 6,664 in-history zeros across 23 markets. panels.futures_layer() applies this at load, but every cell using OI must STATE it, and no zero may enter an OI-growth denominator, an OI-concentration ratio or a basis-OI calculation. This limitation travels with r60_05 and r60_07.
datasets.duplicate_identity_pretest: Basis momentum vs the SETTLED carry slope level: per-decision Spearman mean 0.214, median 0.220, |rho| >= 0.999 on 0 of 185 decisions. DISTINCT. MEASURED BEFORE PRE-REGISTRATION, so the campaign spends no burden charge to learn it and NO CELL MAY RE-RUN IT. It is exploratory evidence of non-identity, not a novelty ruling - memory and the skeptic still rule.
datasets.cost_model: Per-market cost_bps_per_side 2-15 bp from native.load_meta(); MODELLED_NOT_OBSERVED.

datasets.availability_rule: SEC companyfacts + FSDS. Every fact is stamped by its 'filed' date and is visible only at decision dates on or after it. RESTATEMENT RULE: latest-filed-as-of-t per (cik, concept, period). Restatements filed later are invisible to earlier slots.
datasets.survivorship: Full FSDS history retained, including inactive filers. 96 mid/small-cap CIKs (0.6%) are in FSDS but not companyfacts.zip - treat as MISSING, never as zero, and never as a reason to drop the name from the universe mask.
datasets.shares_outstanding: GENUINE filed-stamped history: median 36 observations per issuer, 2009-2026, present for 142/220 sampled issuers. Primary tag us-gaap:CommonStockSharesOutstanding, legitimate fallback dei:EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding. This RESCUED PH04 after DF4A blocked it. Explicitly NOT nd.sharesoutstanding, which is a current scalar and would be look-ahead contaminated.
datasets.MANDATORY_LIMITATION_NON_POSITIVE_SHARES: DROP NON-POSITIVE SHARE COUNTS BEFORE ANY RATIO. A sampled issuer carries -25,878,050 later corrected to +25,878,050; a ratio spanning that sign flip parks the name at a cross-sectional extreme every decision and manufactures a factor out of a data error. This limitation travels with r60_02 and is pre-registered in the executor, not discovered at evaluation.
limitations: Per-field coverage BY YEAR (2009-2026) is NOT MEASURED. Coverage is non-uniform and smaller filers tag fewer facts; executors must handle missing explicitly and may not assume dense coverage.

ticker->CIK join validated at 99.4% against an FSDS-derived mid/small-cap CIK set, NOT against the certified Norgate extension symbol list. The two join paths must be reconciled at load and the realised join rate reported with the result.

datasets.availability_rule: EODHD /div declarationDate is the availability stamp, never the ex-date (JPM: ex-date 2026-07-06, declarationDate 2026-05-18 -> available_at 2026-05-18, a seven-week gap an ex-date study gets backwards). A record with a null declarationDate is DROPPED, never imputed from the ex-date.
datasets.MANDATORY_LIMITATION_COVERAGE_WINDOW: The 100% figure was measured on 2020-2026 and 25 NAMES ONLY, while discovery starts 2011-07-01. PRE-2020 DECLARATION-DATE COVERAGE IS ASSERTED, NOT MEASURED. It is handled by the pre-registered coverage pre-check on r60_04 (see that cell's sample_start_rule); it does not pass silently.
datasets.survivorship: MEASURED on the full pull (2,687 ever-member symbols, 7.6 MB): 918 of 1,378 live symbols and 531 of 1,291 delisted symbols returned dividend records. EODHD serves delisted tickers only partially - 41% against 67% - so the event population is tilted toward survivors even though it is not survivor-only. The field is stated because the pipeline requires it, and because a PIT_SAFE claim carrying no survivorship treatment is the shape of every survivor-biased result this estate has had to withdraw.
datasets.PRECHECK_OUTCOME: FAILED; r60_04 therefore HALTS. The pre-registered blocking gate - non-null declarationDate >= 0.80 in EVERY year 2011-2023, frozen before measurement - failed on 2011 = 0.7165 and 2012 = 0.7819. Every year from 2013 clears it at about 0.99. Per the frozen rule there is NO ex-date fallback and NO post-hoc truncation: the cell settles as UNMEASURABLE_COVERAGE and charges the burden. The measured coverage is published either way, which is exactly what the rule promised.

universes.rules: Names flagged as S&P MidCap 400 or SmallCap 600 members at t under the panel's own point-in-time membership flag, with unadjusted price >= $1.00 and median 63-session dollar turnover >= $100k over the window CLOSED AT t-1, and a finite adjusted price at t and at the entry bar. The tradability filter was chosen from data alone with no return scored. Measured cross-section: median 1000, min 978.
universes.short_leg_note: The short leg is NOT declared expressible. Borrow availability and borrow cost for MidCap400/SmallCap600 names are not measured anywhere in this estate, so every equity cell in this campaign is a LONG-ONLY book against the equal-weight eligible universe (an excess-return book). A long-short number here would price a short leg nobody has shown can be held.

universes.rules: r60_eq_extension_core INTERSECTED with a successful ticker->CIK join and with the required fact available under latest-filed-as-of-t at the decision date. Non-positive share counts are dropped BEFORE any ratio. A name whose required fact is missing is UNSCORED, not zero-scored, and the realised scored fraction of the eligible core universe must be reported per decision with the result.

r60_eq_extension_core INTERSECTED with at least one dividend record whose declarationDate falls in the 63 sessions ending t-1 and whose declarationDate is non-null. Records with a null declarationDate are dropped. The book is flat on any decision scoring fewer than 20 event names.

Certified r59-class COMMODITY_FUTURES markets with a finite front return at t, a finite deferred return ret2 on at least 17 of the 21 own sessions ending t-1, and at least 2,000 paired sessions in history. Own sessions are counted, never grid slots. Measured paired grid: 187 decisions, 2011-07-01 .. 2026-07-07, median 66 scorable markets per decision across all classes.

Certified COMMODITY_FUTURES markets with a finite return at t and STRICTLY POSITIVE open interest on at least 40 of the 63 own sessions ending t-2. open_interest == 0 is MISSING, so a market carrying zeros is thinned, never zero-filled. The book is flat unless at least 12 markets are scored.

The certified non-US equity index futures markets (R38 groups INTL_INDEX_FUTURES and INTL_INDEX_FUTURES_EMERGING) with a finite return at t and strictly positive open interest on at least 40 of the 63 own sessions ending t-2. The book is flat unless at least 8 markets are scored.

The certified RATES_FUTURES, FX_FUTURES and EQUITY_INDEX_FUTURES markets - DISJOINT BY CONSTRUCTION from r60_commodity_paired_leg, which holds every COMMODITY_FUTURES market - with a finite front return at t, a finite ret2 on at least 17 of the 21 own sessions ending t-1, and at least 2,000 paired sessions. The instrument sets of r60_01 and r60_06 share NO market; that disjointness is what makes r60_06 replication evidence rather than a second look at the same data.

features.name: basis_momentum_63d
features.formula: sum of front log returns (ret) over the 63 own sessions ending t-1 MINUS sum of first-deferred log returns (ret2) over the SAME 63 own sessions ending t-1. Sessions on which either leg is NaN are excluded from BOTH sums so the two cumulations always span the identical session set. No open interest enters this feature.

features.name: economic_group_demean
features.formula: subtract the mean basis_momentum_63d of the market's R38 economic group, computed over scored members only

features.name: net_share_issuance_1y
features.formula: log(S_t / S_{t-252}) where S_t is the share count from the LATEST filing whose filed date is strictly before the decision date, and S_{t-252} is the share count from the latest filing whose filed date is strictly before the calendar date 252 sessions earlier - i.e. the value that WAS KNOWN a year ago, not the value now believed about a year ago. Primary tag us-gaap:CommonStockSharesOutstanding, fallback dei:EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding. NON-POSITIVE COUNTS ARE DROPPED BEFORE THE RATIO on both ends; a name with a non-positive count at either end is UNSCORED. A name whose two filings are the same filing is UNSCORED.

features.name: gross_profit_to_assets
features.formula: us-gaap:GrossProfit for the most recent annual or trailing-four-quarter period available under latest-filed-as-of-t, divided by us-gaap:Assets from the latest filing available at t. Where GrossProfit is untagged, the legitimate fallback is Revenues minus CostOfRevenue from the SAME filing; mixing periods across filings is not permitted. Non-positive Assets is UNSCORED. No winsorisation, no imputation.

features.name: declared_dividend_change_score
features.formula: For each name, take the dividend record with the LATEST declarationDate in the 63 sessions ending t-1. Score = log(new regular cash amount / previous regular cash amount for the same name) using the previous record by declarationDate; an INITIATION (no prior record in the trailing 756 sessions) scores +0.25 and an OMISSION (a scheduled regular dividend whose declared amount is 0) scores -0.25, both fixed before measurement. Special and non-recurring dividends are excluded. A record with a null declarationDate is DROPPED and never dated by its ex-date.

features.name: log_oi_growth_21_63
features.formula: log( mean open interest over the 21 own sessions ending t-2 / mean open interest over the 63 own sessions ending t-2 ), computed on the HELD dated contract. open_interest == 0 is MISSING and is excluded from both means; a window with fewer than 15 (respectively 40) positive observations leaves the market UNSCORED. No zero ever enters a denominator.

features.name: economic_group_demean
features.formula: subtract the scored-member mean of log_oi_growth_21_63 within the market's R38 economic group

features.name: basis_momentum_63d
features.formula: IDENTICAL formula to fs_r60_01_basis_momentum_commodity, applied to the disjoint rates/FX/equity-index instrument set. The formula is copied, not re-chosen: any deviation from r60_01's construction destroys the replication and converts this cell into a second independent test.

features.name: r59_asset_class_demean
features.formula: subtract the scored-member mean within r59 asset class (RATES_FUTURES, FX_FUTURES, EQUITY_INDEX_FUTURES) rather than economic group, because these classes have too few members per economic group to demean within one

features.name: log_oi_growth_21_63
features.formula: IDENTICAL formula to fs_r60_05_oi_growth_commodity, applied to the non-US index markets, with no demeaning: the universe is a single economic group.

features.name: turnover_weighted_5d_return
features.formula: ( cumulative adjusted log return over the 5 sessions ending t-1 ) MULTIPLIED by ( clipped log ratio of mean dollar turnover over the 5 sessions ending t-1 to mean dollar turnover over the 63 sessions ending t-1, clipped to [-1.0, 1.0] ). A single product, one parameter-free rule; the two legs are never scored separately and no threshold is fitted.
features.source: us_equity_extension_pit_panel_v1 adjusted close, unadjusted close x volume

EQ_EXT_25BP_V1.owner: EQ_EXT_COST_RATE in the frozen R60 evaluator
EQ_EXT_25BP_V1.note: 25 bp/side, double the S&P 500 rate, set before any return was scored because the extension universe is mid and small caps.

EQ_EXT_50BP_ADVERSARIAL_V1.note: The doubled-cost attack. For r60_08 it is a PRIMARY reported result, not a robustness footnote, because a 5-session small-cap book is exactly where a cost assumption manufactures alpha.

review_order_rule: BINDING, and also the EXECUTION order, because a halted cell settles and charges the burden denominator exactly like a reviewed one. Ordered by ex-ante conviction so the strongest ideas pay the smallest denominator: the two cells resting on information the estate has never held (the deferred leg, r60_01; filed share-count history, r60_02) go first, the two other genuine-information cells next (r60_03, r60_04), then the positioning cells (r60_05), then the declared variants after their parents (r60_06 after r60_01; r60_07 after r60_05), and the lowest-conviction price-and-turnover cell last (r60_08).

experiments.label: FUT_BASIS_MOMENTUM_COMMODITY
experiments.hypothesis: The difference between the cumulative return of the FRONT contract and that of the FIRST-DEFERRED contract over the 63 own sessions ending t-1, demeaned within economic group, predicts the next 21 sessions of front-contract return cross-sectionally across commodity markets, POSITIVELY, net of per-market and roll cost.
experiments.mechanism: Basis momentum captures the CHANGE in the shape of the curve - the evolving imbalance between hedging demand at different maturities - rather than the static LEVEL of carry. A curve whose front is outrunning its deferred is a curve where nearby hedging pressure is intensifying, and the speculator absorbing it is paid.
experiments.information_edge: It is only computable with a genuine deferred leg. futures_panel_v1 cannot supply one; the R38 dated layer now can, measured on 187 decisions with a median 66 scorable markets. This leg was RESCUED after an agent reported it unavailable.
experiments.why_market_may_not_fully_price_it: It requires maintaining two contract series per market with correct roll handling on both - an infrastructure cost most participants avoid, which is why price-only participants see the level of the curve and not its motion.
experiments.execution_assumption: Decision at t uses windows ending t-1 (SIGNAL_LAG_SESSIONS = 1). Positions are notional, dollar-neutral, unit gross, held 21 sessions. Roll cost is charged at entry and at every interior roll.
experiments.rebalance_rule: Full rebalance to the rank-centred dollar-neutral unit-gross target, no smoothing. Feature-side turnover is MEASURED BY THE EXECUTOR and reported; above the 0.40 ceiling the cell HALTS and is not re-smoothed into compliance.
required_disclosures: EFFECTIVE OBSERVATION COUNT REPORTED UP FRONT, before any t-statistic. CALENDAR_TERM_STRUCTURE_ROLL_STATE_R59 was withdrawn on ~14 effective observations and this cell will be killed for the same reason if it hides the number.

The distinction from the SETTLED COMMODITY_CURVE_CARRY_SPREADS family must be stated in the pre-registered text: that family scored the slope LEVEL; this is the second difference, the CHANGE in the front-deferred relation.

The duplicate-identity pre-test is ALREADY MEASURED (per-decision Spearman vs the settled carry slope: mean 0.214, median 0.220, |rho| >= 0.999 on 0 of 185 decisions). RECORD IT; DO NOT RE-RUN IT. It is exploratory and does not itself rule on novelty.

experiments.label: EQ_EXTENSION_NET_SHARE_ISSUANCE
experiments.hypothesis: In the MidCap400+SmallCap600 extension universe, firms that INCREASED shares outstanding over the prior year underperform: a long-only book of the 100 names with the LOWEST net share issuance (the repurchasers), equal-weighted against the equal-weight eligible universe, earns a positive 21-session excess return net of 25 bp per side. Expected sign is -1 on the feature; the long-only book therefore holds the bottom of the feature, exactly as the settled EQ_OPERATING_PROFITABILITY_STABILITY construction did, and NO SIGN IS FLIPPED AT EVALUATION.
experiments.mechanism: Managers issue equity when they believe it is expensive and repurchase when they believe it is cheap. The share count is a revealed managerial valuation opinion backed by the firm's own money - an action, not a forecast. That is why the routed family is VALUATION and not CORPORATE_FINANCING, which is not a routed family and would be refused.
experiments.information_edge: Filed share-count HISTORY - median 36 filed-stamped observations per issuer, 2009-2026 - which this estate has never held and which was RESCUED after DF4A blocked the cell. Explicitly NOT nd.sharesoutstanding, a current scalar (263909000.0 stamped 2026-07-31) whose use would be look-ahead contamination.
experiments.why_market_may_not_fully_price_it: The dilution is gradual and the disclosure is a cover-page number with no announcement moment to react to. Small caps issue and dilute far more aggressively than large caps, so the signal has more variance to work with exactly where fewer people are reading.
experiments.execution_assumption: Score computed from filings STRICTLY BEFORE the decision date under latest-filed-as-of-t; equal-weight top 100 by the ranked score, next-close entry, held 21 sessions. Long-only against the equal-weight eligible universe; NO SHORT LEG, because small-cap borrow is not measured anywhere in this estate.
experiments.cost_model_note: The 63-session economic claim of the Phase-1 statement is expressed as a 21-session holding period with monthly re-ranking of a slow annual signal, because EQUITY_TOPN is an H21 book. The signal LOOKBACK is one year; the HOLDING period is 21 sessions. This is declared here, before measurement, and the executor may not substitute a 63-session hold.
experiments.rebalance_rule: Equal-weight top 100, next-close entry, monthly re-rank. Feature-side turnover measured and reported; above 0.40 the cell HALTS.
required_disclosures: MANDATORY: non-positive share counts are DROPPED BEFORE ANY RATIO. A sampled issuer carries -25,878,050 later corrected to +25,878,050; a ratio spanning that sign flip parks the name at a cross-sectional extreme every decision.
MANDATORY: restatement rule is latest-filed-as-of-t, per (cik, concept, period).

Per-field coverage BY YEAR is NOT MEASURED. The realised scored fraction of the eligible universe must be reported per decision alongside the result, and a decision scoring fewer than 150 names is reported as thin, not silently averaged in.
The ticker->CIK join was validated at 99.4% against an FSDS-derived CIK set, NOT against the Norgate extension symbol list. The realised join rate against the actual traded universe must be reported.

experiments.label: EQ_EXTENSION_GROSS_PROFITABILITY
experiments.hypothesis: In the extension universe, a long-only book of the 100 names with the HIGHEST gross profits scaled by total assets - built only from SEC facts whose filed date precedes the decision date - earns a positive 21-session excess return against the equal-weight eligible universe, net of 25 bp per side.
experiments.mechanism: Gross profitability is the cleanest available measure of productive efficiency, sitting above the accounting lines most exposed to managerial discretion. Profitable firms out-earn unprofitable ones and the market underweights how persistent that is.
experiments.information_edge: Point-in-time fundamentals for a population where accounting quality is more dispersed and analyst coverage thinner, from companyfacts rather than the 885-name S&P 500 fundamental panel the estate has already mined.
experiments.why_market_may_not_fully_price_it: Small-cap fundamentals are expensive to process relative to the position size they can support; nobody is paid to read a $900m company's cost of revenue line.
experiments.execution_assumption: Equal-weight top 100, next-close entry, held 21 sessions, long-only against the equal-weight eligible universe. NO SHORT LEG.
experiments.rebalance_rule: Equal-weight top 100, next-close entry, monthly re-rank. Feature-side turnover measured and reported; above 0.40 the cell HALTS.
required_disclosures: PIT_FUNDAMENTALS_AND_VALUATION is closed with the explicit scope qualifier '(S&P 500)'. This is a different population AND a profitability rather than valuation construct; the pre-registered text must say so and the memory check must agree.
Per-field coverage BY YEAR is NOT MEASURED; report the realised scored fraction per decision.
Where GrossProfit is untagged, the ONLY permitted fallback is Revenues minus CostOfRevenue from the SAME filing. No cross-filing construction, no imputation, no winsorisation.

experiments.label: EQ_DIVIDEND_DECLARATION_DRIFT
experiments.sample_start_rule: COVERAGE PRE-CHECK, PRE-REGISTERED, BLOCKING. The certification measured 100% non-null declarationDate on 2020-2026 and 25 NAMES ONLY; pre-2020 coverage is ASSERTED, NOT MEASURED, and discovery starts 2011-07-01. Truncating the sample to 2020 is NOT available as a remedy, because the discovery layer ENDS 2018-01-01 and a 2020 start would leave the cell zero discovery decisions - it would not be a shorter test, it would be no test. The cell therefore runs from 2011-07-01 under a blocking executor-side pre-check: BEFORE any return is scored, measure the non-null declarationDate fraction per calendar year 2011-2026 over the full extension universe's dividend records. If ANY year in 2011-2023 falls below 0.80 non-null - the same threshold the certification itself used - the cell HALTS, settles, charges the burden denominator and reports UNMEASURABLE COVERAGE. It does NOT fall back to ex-dates, does not truncate to the covered window after seeing the coverage, and does not proceed on a partial year. The threshold and the years are frozen here, before the measurement, so the outcome cannot be rounded into a pass.
experiments.hypothesis: Firms that ANNOUNCE a dividend increase or initiation - dated by DECLARATION date, never by ex-date - outperform over the following 21 sessions: a long-only equal-weight book of up to 100 names with the highest declared_dividend_change_score among declarations in the trailing 63 sessions, entered at the next open after the decision, against the equal-weight eligible universe, net of 25 bp per side.
experiments.mechanism: Dividend policy is sticky and management is reluctant to cut. Raising the dividend is a costly, credible commitment about expected future cash flow; cutting it is a confession. The action is expensive to fake, and the market underreacts to it - which is why the routed family is FUNDAMENTAL_MOMENTUM (continuation, expected_sign +1) and NOT EVENT_OVERREACTION, whose sign would be the opposite of the claim.
experiments.information_edge: The declaration date itself, verified on disk in the EODHD /div payload and carried into the availability stamp (JPM: ex-date 2026-07-06, declarationDate 2026-05-18 -> available_at 2026-05-18). A seven-week gap that any ex-date-based study gets backwards.
experiments.why_market_may_not_fully_price_it: Dividend announcements are unscheduled, unglamorous and scattered across the calendar; they attract none of the attention an earnings date does, least of all in mid and small caps.
experiments.execution_assumption: Event window is the 63 sessions ending t-1, holding period 21 sessions, entry at the NEXT OPEN after the decision. Long-only; NO SHORT LEG - the cut-and-omission side is NOT traded, it only defines the score's lower tail, because shorting a small-cap dividend cutter requires borrow this estate has not measured.
experiments.rebalance_rule: Equal-weight up to 100 event names, next-open entry, monthly re-rank, flat on any decision with fewer than 20 event names. Feature-side turnover measured and reported; above 0.40 the cell HALTS.
required_disclosures: DIVIDEND_MONTH_DEMAND_PREMIUM is closed - that is seasonal demand for yield around the EX-DATE, a flow story with no announcement in it. This is an information event dated by the announcement. The pre-registered text must state the distinction.
Report the measured per-year declarationDate coverage from the pre-check ALONGSIDE the result, whatever the outcome. A pass on coverage is a measurement and must be published as one.
Records with a null declarationDate are DROPPED. Never date an event by its ex-date.

experiments.label: FUT_OPEN_INTEREST_GROWTH_COMMODITY
experiments.hypothesis: Ranking commodity markets by the trailing growth in EXCHANGE open interest on the held dated contract - 21-session mean over 63-session mean, both windows ending t-2, demeaned within economic group - and going SHORT the fastest open-interest expansion against LONG the contracting markets earns a positive 21-session net return.
experiments.mechanism: Rapid open-interest growth means new capital is crowding into a position. Crowded positions are fragile: they need continued inflow to sustain the price and they unwind violently. Open interest measures how much capital must eventually exit.
experiments.information_edge: Real exchange open interest PER DATED CONTRACT, present across all 27,451 dated Norgate symbols in the R38 native layer. Twelve hypotheses have ever touched this layer against 5,846 on the back-adjusted panel.
experiments.why_market_may_not_fully_price_it: Open interest is published with a provisional lag and is revised, so it is awkward to use and most systematic participants ignore it in favour of price.
experiments.execution_assumption: OI_LAG = 2 sessions with a provisional newest row: open interest at date T is not used at T or T-1, so both windows close at t-2. Notional, dollar-neutral, unit gross, held 21 sessions, roll cost charged.
experiments.rebalance_rule: Full rebalance to the rank-centred dollar-neutral unit-gross target, no smoothing. Feature-side turnover measured and reported; above 0.40 the cell HALTS.
required_disclosures: MANDATORY: open_interest == 0.0 is MISSING EVERYWHERE - 63 provisional newest rows plus 6,664 in-history zeros across 23 markets. panels.futures_layer() applies the rule at load, but this cell must STATE it, must exclude zeros from both window means, and must leave a thin market UNSCORED rather than impute. A zero in a growth denominator manufactures the signal.

COT_HEDGING_PRESSURE is closed. This cell MUST NOT use CFTC trader categories at all: it is total exchange open interest, a different quantity from a different publisher on a daily rather than weekly clock. The pre-registered text must say so.
Report the number of markets scored per decision and the number thinned out by the zero-is-missing rule.

experiments.label: XA_BASIS_MOMENTUM_REPLICATION
experiments.hypothesis: Basis momentum is a FUTURES fact, not a commodity fact: the identical front-minus-deferred 63-session return difference, demeaned within r59 asset class, predicts 21-session returns POSITIVELY across the DISJOINT set of rates, FX and equity-index futures markets.
experiments.mechanism: The same evolving-hedging-imbalance mechanism, asked where its premise differs. Rates and FX curves are shaped by funding and policy expectations rather than storage; a curve-motion premium that exists only in commodities is a storage story, and one that generalises is a risk-transfer story. Either answer is informative about r60_01.
experiments.information_edge: The same rescued deferred leg, on an instrument set that shares NO market with r60_01.
experiments.why_market_may_not_fully_price_it: Same two-series infrastructure cost, and in rates and FX the deferred contract is even more thinly followed than in commodities.
experiments.execution_assumption: Identical to r60_01: windows ending t-1, notional dollar-neutral unit gross, 21-session hold, roll cost charged.
experiments.rebalance_rule: Full rebalance, no smoothing - identical to r60_01. Feature-side turnover measured and reported; above 0.40 the cell HALTS.
experiments.replication_protocol: PRE-DECLARED REPLICATION, the census's rank 7. It is its own family key and is charged to the burden SEPARATELY. It is evidence about r60_01 ONLY IF r60_01 is measured FIRST and r60_06's construction is not touched afterwards - which is why the review order puts it after its parent and why its feature formula is declared as a COPY. If r60_01's parameters are changed for any reason, r60_06 ceases to be a replication and becomes an independent test that must be re-registered as one.
required_disclosures: The instrument sets of r60_01 and r60_06 are DISJOINT BY CONSTRUCTION and that disjointness must be verified at load and reported, not assumed.
EFFECTIVE OBSERVATION COUNT REPORTED UP FRONT.
This cell is NOT evidence in its own right for a cross-asset carry claim: EQUITY_INDEX_CROSS_ASSET_CARRY_R64 is closed and this is the second difference, not the level.

experiments.label: FUT_INTL_INDEX_OPEN_INTEREST_GROWTH
experiments.hypothesis: Across the certified non-US equity index futures markets, the identical trailing growth in exchange open interest on the held contract - 21-session mean over 63-session mean, windows ending t-2, no demeaning - predicts LOWER subsequent 21-session returns cross-sectionally.
experiments.mechanism: The same crowding mechanism as r60_05, applied where capital flows are lumpier. International index futures are the vehicle for cross-border allocation, so open-interest expansion is a direct measure of foreign capital arriving - and arriving capital eventually leaves.
experiments.information_edge: Real per-contract open interest across the non-US index markets in the R38 dated layer. EQUITY_INDEX_FUTURES carries 923 settled tests and ALL of them are price-state; this is a positioning quantity, not a price transform.
experiments.why_market_may_not_fully_price_it: Cross-border allocation decisions are made on quarterly committee cycles, so the flow is predictable in direction and slow in execution.
experiments.execution_assumption: Identical lag discipline to r60_05 (OI usable only through t-2). Notional, dollar-neutral, unit gross, 21-session hold, roll cost charged. Flat unless at least 8 markets are scored.
experiments.rebalance_rule: Full rebalance, no smoothing - identical to r60_05. Feature-side turnover measured and reported; above 0.40 the cell HALTS.
required_disclosures: MANDATORY: open_interest == 0.0 is MISSING everywhere; same exclusion rule as r60_05, same thin-market reporting.
EQUITY_INDEX_CROSS_ASSET_CARRY_R64 is closed and this is not carry; INTL_INDEX_TREND_FX_REVERSAL_XA_CURVE is closed and this is not trend. The pre-registered text must state both non-identities.

This is a SECOND application of r60_05's mechanism to a different asset class, declared as such, reviewed after its parent, and counted inside the POSITIONING family against the three-variants-per-idea limit. Its standalone evidential value is low; its value is telling a commodity fact from a futures fact.

experiments.label: EQ_EXTENSION_H5_IMMEDIACY_REVERSAL
experiments.hypothesis: In the extension universe, the names with the most negative turnover-weighted 5-session return - the largest declines made on abnormally elevated own-name turnover - out-earn the equal-weight eligible universe over the following 5 sessions, entered at the next open. Expected sign is -1 on the feature, so the long-only book holds the BOTTOM 100 of the ranked feature. No sign is flipped at evaluation.
experiments.mechanism: Payment for immediacy. A seller who must exit now moves the price against themselves; whoever absorbs the inventory is compensated when the price recovers. The compensation is larger where market-making capital is scarcer, and the turnover multiplier is what distinguishes a forced exit from information being priced - stated as ONE parameter-free product so the hypothesis is falsifiable in a single test.
experiments.information_edge: Horizon, not data: H1-H5 is 0.45% of the entire estate (38 tests) and equity short-horizon reversal is closed only on the S&P 500. This is the campaign's LOWEST-conviction cell and its weakest information claim - it is a price-and-turnover construct on a new population - and it is reviewed last for exactly that reason.
experiments.why_market_may_not_fully_price_it: Providing immediacy in small caps requires balance sheet and risk tolerance that is genuinely scarce; the compensation is a real fee for a real service, not a mispricing.
experiments.execution_assumption: EQUITY_DAILY_TRANCHE: next-OPEN entry via op_tr, 5-session hold, hold band and embargo as the book defines them, long-only against the equal-weight eligible universe. NO SHORT LEG.
experiments.rebalance_rule: Daily tranche, equal-weight bottom 100 of the ranked feature, next-open entry, 5-session hold with the book's hold band. Feature-side turnover is MEASURED and reported; above the 0.40 one-way ceiling the cell HALTS, settles and charges the burden - it is NOT re-smoothed, re-banded or re-tranched into compliance, because that would be a new experiment.
required_disclosures: THE DOUBLED-COST RESULT IS A PRIMARY REPORTED NUMBER, NOT A FOOTNOTE. Report net performance under BOTH EQ_EXT_25BP_V1 and EQ_EXT_50BP_ADVERSARIAL_V1 in the same table. A 5-session small-cap book is exactly where a cost assumption manufactures alpha, and a result that survives only at 25 bp is reported as a cost-model artefact.
SHORT_HORIZON_REVERSAL_GAP_FADE is closed with the explicit scope qualifier '(S&P 500)'. The pre-registered text must state the population distinction.
